run.notes: Actual restrictions: only inputs.json read; prior implementation context exists; same-model synthetic exercise, not external validation.

d001.label: UNCHANGED
d001.reason: The same private-note removal prerequisite appears under a different heading; its timing and required action are preserved.

d002.label: ADDED
d002.reason: The complete target requires only package name and version; the variant additionally requires source retrieval time.

d003.label: MODIFIED
d003.reason: On the same timeout condition, stopping is replaced by continuing with recorded versions and reporting their age.

d004.label: REMOVED
d004.reason: The preview prerequisite disappears from the complete variant, with no replacement preview instruction.

d005.label: UNCHANGED
d005.reason: Both formulations prohibit granting write access until a dry run has succeeded.

d006.label: ADDED
d006.reason: The variant introduces logging each retry before sending it; that requirement is absent from the complete target.

d007.label: MODIFIED
d007.reason: The migration prerequisite changes from two successful sample reads to three.

d008.label: UNCHANGED
d008.reason: The focused requirement to retain the original filename is identical in both documents; output line count is a separate addition.

d009.label: REMOVED
d009.reason: The audit-entry requirement is absent from the complete variant while synchronization and final-status printing remain.

d010.label: ABSTAIN
d010.reason: The target is only an excerpt, so omitted sections could already require unit tests before publication.

d011.label: MODIFIED
d011.reason: The stale-lock response changes from removing the lock and retrying to preserving the lock and stopping.

d012.label: UNCHANGED
d012.reason: Both wordings require exactly one log entry after synchronization completes.

d013.label: ADDED
d013.reason: The variant adds a requirement that the troubleshooting note retain the final error code.

d014.label: REMOVED
d014.reason: The complete variant no longer specifies rejecting files above one megabyte and supplies no replacement size rule.

d015.label: MODIFIED
d015.reason: The integration-blocking condition broadens from failed tests to failure of any test, lint, or formatting check.

d016.label: ABSTAIN
d016.reason: The variant is only an excerpt; destination-path recording could remain in an omitted section.
